name: MCP Servers
blurb: External tools + data the fleet's agents can call.
prompt:
Connect the external tools and data sources the fleet's agents need via MCP servers.
Assign one with `bsc-plan mcp add "…"` (e.g. `bsc-plan mcp add Compliance`): a first-party server
(Compliance, Complexity Analyzer, Dependency Graph) downloads automatically — the user builds it
once in the MCP panel and it's scoped to every session this plan launches (the director AND every
worker). `bsc-plan mcp list` shows the assigned servers. Assign only the servers the agents
actually need.

Gate: the project's agents have the MCP servers they need (optional).
